steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; node --version; npm --version; node -e "console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(globalThis, 'localStorage'))"

steps.name: apply-quality-fixes
frontend-quality
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts; npm run quality:frontend

steps.name: commit-and-push
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git diff --check; git status --short; git add interface/vite.config.ts interface/src/test/setup.ts interface/src/lib/storage.svelte.ts interface/src/routes/charts/components/DateSelector.svelte interface/src/lib/features/gpio/gpioModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/power/powerConfigModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/matrix/matrixNavigation.ts interface/src/lib/features/system/matrix/matrixModel.ts interface/src/lib/features/usb/terminal/usbTerminalCommandPresets.ts interface/src/lib/features/usb/terminal/useUsbTerminalQuickScripts.svelte.ts; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Fix frontend quality debt'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
